svg.title: Weekends are for resting
svg.desc: Mimlet checks the last 371 days of contributions against the property that weekends are for resting. 8 weekend days had 40 or more contributions; the worst was Sunday 5 Jul with 154.

text.tspan: checking 371 days: weekends are for resting (< 40)
